worldcombat.skill.powerswap.summary: Temporarily exchange Attack and Sp. Atk stages with a chosen ally or foe. Only this exchange expires; later stage changes remain.
worldcombat.skill.powerswap.use.0: Take the Attack and Sp. Atk the foe has built up
worldcombat.skill.powerswap.use.1: Dump your own lowered Attack onto the foe
worldcombat.skill.powerswap.use.2: Steal the momentum once the foe has set up
Switch Attack and Sp. Atk stat changes with a target within %1$s blocks, held for %2$s; a clear line is required.
The temporary exchange owns only the difference between current stages. Expiry or removal withdraws that contribution while preserving later independent changes.
worldcombat.skill.powerswap.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP to switch, then %3$s seconds to recover and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.powerswap.growth.0: At level %1$s the switch reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.powerswap.growth.1: At level %1$s the switch reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.powerswap.preference.a: The companion only switches when the threat is within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases the momentum farther out.
The foe's combined Attack and Sp. Atk stages must exceed yours by this many steps. Higher is pickier and waits for a real set-up; lower casts more often.
On: it leaves its station under a hold order to switch. Off: it only casts when the target is already in reach.
Choose an ally or foe. Either existing swap window prevents another swap; equal stages need no exchange.
worldcombat.skill.powerswap.preference.a: Allow giving your higher stages to an ally; off by default.
